name: Satyr of the Night

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Shadow Dweller
traits.details: The satyr has partial concealment. Whenever the satyr gains concealment from dim light, the satyr is instead invisible.

hit.description: damage, ongoing 10 necrotic damage (save ends), and 3d8 extra damage to a dazed or dominated target.
The target is dominated until the end of the satyr’s next turn.

miss.description: The target is dazed until the end of the satyr’s next turn.

effect.description: The satyr slides the target up to 5 squares to a square adjacent to itself.

powers.name: Lure Away
powers.requirements: The satyr must have a creature dominated.

effect.description: The satyr shifts up to its speed, and an adjacent creature that the satyr is dominating is pulled along with it, staying adjacent to the satyr during the movement.

powers.name: Charmed Target
powers.trigger: A melee or ranged attack targets the satyr while it is adjacent to a creature dominated or dazed by the satyr’s words of enchantment.

effect.description: The triggering attack instead targets the creature affected by the satyr’s words of enchantment.
The satyr teleports up to 10 squares and becomes invisible until it hits or misses with an attack or until the end of its next turn.
